body.message:
We do not accept this deduction and reject your claim that we are responsible for the alleged damage to the table.

You have not provided any evidence that the table was undamaged prior to our check-in or that we caused the damage. Given that the furniture has been in the apartment for years and the property has accommodated multiple guests before our stay, it is unreasonable to hold us liable without clear proof.

The fact that you have reduced the charge from AED 2,500 to AED 1,000 as a “gesture of goodwill” does not establish that we are responsible for the damage. It simply confirms that the original amount was arbitrary. We are not willing to pay for damage that has not been proven to have occurred during our tenancy.

We also disagree with your statement that all maintenance issues were resolved promptly. From the day we checked in, the apartment was not professionally cleaned, several household items were either faulty or barely functional, and we experienced repeated issues throughout our stay.

Unless you can provide dated evidence demonstrating that the table was in good condition immediately before our tenancy and that we caused the alleged damage, we expect our full security deposit to be returned without any deductions.

If the deduction proceeds without sufficient evidence, we will have no option but to escalate this matter through the appropriate consumer protection and regulatory channels.

We look forward to your confirmation that our full security deposit will be refunded.
